heading: Get started in minutes
subheading: Momentum is 60 seconds away. No complex setup. No "productivity systems" to learn. Fleent is designed to get out of your way so you can finally get started.

steps.title: Sync your space.
steps.body: One-tap calendar integration. Connect your Google or Outlook calendar. Fleent doesn't just show your meetings; it scans for the quiet gaps where your best work actually happens.

image.alt: A weekly calendar showing open gaps between meetings.

steps.title: Dump the noise.
steps.body: Speak or type your chaos. Brain-dump your tasks without worrying about formatting or priority. Our AI extracts the actionable bits and nominates the top 3 that fit your current energy level.

image.alt: A 'what are you doing today?' input with Fleent adding the task underneath.

steps.title: Flip to begin.
steps.body: The first step is the smallest. Tap the Saffron "Flip" button on any task. Watch your "Big Project" turn into a 10-second physical action. Do that one thing, and the rest will follow.

image.alt: Streak stats above a kitten care checklist on a lavender panel.
